svg.title: Interpretation limits
svg.desc: Wall times include model inference and run under shared machine load. Broker call times include MCP handling, action waits, two upstream validation calls and image hashing; they are not pure engine latency. The Python Playwright control connection uses the upstream 100 ms slow-motion setting; the Umbra control connection has no equivalent delay. Broker durations therefore do not support a browser speedup claim. Installation is outside the timing. Codex reports token usage but no dollar cost for this subscription run.
